service.description: Share the caller's own location by a guest link for a record's customer: recordType workOrder (a Maintenance work order, recordId its WorkEffort or a step of it) to which the caller is assigned (a current Assignee row) with MAINTENANCE_EXECUTE or MAINTENANCE_SUPERVISE, open (not complete, closed or cancelled), with a planned end (estimatedCompletionDate) not yet past and a customer (a customer repair's claim customer). The share ends at thruDate (after now, no later than the planned end; the planned end when not given), exact or approximate (precisionEnumId), with the caller's purposeText (an ETA); it is the framework's create#Share with a link audience, made as the caller, and names the work order and its planned end (store#ShareRecord), so no extension passes that end and the work order's completion or cancellation stops it. The link (linkUrl: this server's https web root and the guest page's /location/selector#secret) is answered this once and mailed only by send#RecordGuestLink. recordType delivery is refused with RECORD_KIND_NOT_READY until the warehouse trips (WH-TRIP) give a Delivery its driver and status. Refused: RECORD_KIND_UNKNOWN, PERMISSION_DENIED, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE (another organization's), NOT_ASSIGNED, WORK_CLOSED, NO_PLANNED_END, OVERDUE, NO_CUSTOMER, BAD_UNTIL, END_AFTER_PLANNED, NO_SITE_ROOT, and create#Share's reasons.

parameter.name: linkUrl
parameter.description: The guest page's link, answered this once

service.description: Mail the guest link of a share of the caller's own made by create#RecordGuestShare to its record's customer, by the record's organization (MANTLE_LOCATION_GUEST_LINK, its date in the customer's or the organization's time zone): once the technician's app confirmed the share, or at once in a browser. The share must be active, its record pass create#RecordGuestShare's checks again, linkSecret be its own link's secret (the fragment of linkUrl), and the link not have been mailed. mailSent false with mailReason NO_CUSTOMER_EMAIL, NO_SENDER (the organization has no email address), NO_MAIL_SERVER (the mail is queued: its server has no host) or MAIL_FAILED. Refused: SHARE_NOT_FOUND, SHARE_ENDED, LINK_MISMATCH, ALREADY_SENT, NO_SITE_ROOT, and the record's refusals.

A Maintenance work order completed, closed or cancelled (the EECA LocationShareWorkOrderEnded), by a user, an import or a job: every guest share still on for it is stopped (the framework's stop#RecordShares, each in its own transaction). It never fails the status change: an error is logged. Out: stoppedCount.

A guest share for a record ended or stopped (the EECA LocationShareGuestEnded, however it ended: its end, its owner's stop, its record's completion, its device's revoke): the link's secret is blanked from the body of the mail that carried it (/location/selector#ended), whose EmailMessage row stays for the mail queue. In a transaction of its own, so it never fails the end: an error is logged. Out: blankedCount.
